scenario_description:
Objective: Add Miriam’s own nebula frames as the no-cost example in a processing-night live stretch demo.
Emerging Need: A possible member-data extra remains unusable until compatibility, eligibility, intake fields, and a short submission window become clear.
Decision Context: Her workbench notes are needed to identify a qualifying dataset and supply exact target, filter, frame count, and folder details without guessing.
Consequence: Timely coordination could give her a tailored processing reference during an event already on the calendar; ignoring it simply leaves the normal processing night unchanged after intake closes.

parameter.title: Sonoran Nightwatchers processing night: live stretch demo
parameter.description: Casual member processing night in the library media room; demo topic to be finalized after equipment checks.
parameter.location: Woods Memorial Library media room, Tucson

parameter.subject: Thursday processing night may include member-data example
parameter.body: The presenter may use one member's small nebula dataset for a live stretch example if tomorrow's laptop test passes. Please do not send files or dataset notes yet; eligibility and intake details are not set.

parameter.content: Quick clinic update: the demo laptop can read FITS files now, and the presenter wants one compact nebula dataset from someone already attending Thursday. They will post the exact intake fields after the 1 PM dry run, so wrong-format details still won't be copied this morning.

parameter.subject: Member-data intake open for Thursday live stretch example
parameter.body: Dry run passed. The intake list is open until 5:30 PM today for one compact emission or planetary nebula dataset from a Thursday attendee. Eligible entries must be under 3 GB zipped and include target name, filter or filter set, light-frame count, and the folder name where the FITS files are stored. The presenter will choose and copy the example tonight.

parameter.content: Processing desk just closed the member-data intake. The presenter has already copied the selected files to the demo laptop and said late datasets cannot be loaded before Thursday.
